jobs.prompt:
Create ONE ORIGINAL SQUARE terrain background tile for the BAICHUAN cultivation-game region, one tile of a continuous 3-by-3 map, not a complete self-contained landscape. Target native 2048x2048 or the largest native square output; no dimensions printed.
Accepted style: sparse FLAT antique game-map line-and-wash. Thin dry grey-brown contour lines; each small low hill only 3-5 loose arcing fold lines; very pale grey-olive wash; tiny dark muted olive tree marks; neutral light ivory-grey paper with fine QUIET texture. The separate approved style reference is the style authority. No vivid cyan/blue mountains, lush qinglu painting, realistic rock faces, dramatic lighting, clouds, panoramic horizon, ornate scroll painting or giant foreground peaks. Consistent miniature feature scale in every tile. Paper color should be almost neutral warm grey-cream, not saturated orange, yellow or sepia. Approximately 65-75 percent quiet usable ground.
Guide image is GEOGRAPHY ONLY: blue lines identify river centerlines, blue small polygons are lakes, grey lines are low-ridge direction. Do NOT copy the guide's polygon region borders or background colors. Rivers are restrained flat grey-blue with thin subdued banks and a few reeds, not luminous azure ribbons. Shape and edge-entry locations must follow guide. Natural region transitions, no borders framing a tile.
BAICHUAN CHARACTER: connected river valleys, lakes and basins, foothill passes, old marshes and northeast near-sea transitions. Region names do not authorize copying any existing game's geography or landmarks. These are nine natural pieces of ONE region, not nine political realms, islands or differently colored biomes.
Terrain ONLY: absolutely NO buildings, sect gates, cities, boats, bridges, roads, path dashes, circles, stone waypoints, labels, characters, icons, map title, grid, frame, legends, calligraphy, seal, watermark or signature. Future places/paths/UI are separate layers. Preserve plenty of open ground; do not use hill silhouettes to cover major future node sites.
Tile edges must continue naturally and calmly into neighboring terrain. Keep corner and edge paper tone consistent with the style reference. Never decorate each tile with a mountain frame. Neighbor images, when supplied, are BORDER/PALETTE references, not additional tile subjects to copy into this tile.
SPECIFIC TILE: bc_bg_11 西北源岭. Western upper watershed and mountain-front country. Low broken grey-olive ridges descend from the left and upper-left, opening toward the east and southeast. Several small SHALLOW tributary rills and moist grassy hollows gather eastward; this is an inhabited river-and-lake region, not a dry wasteland. No snow, desert or giant cliff wall. River corridors shown in blue are authoritative; little decorative feeder rills must remain thin and subordinate. Five future places need generous open foothill flats. Lower and right borders transition to valley land, not a closed enclosing mountain frame.
